## Why this matters
PR #250 was merged to `main` on 2026-06-14 without closing its R81 audit findings. This issue tracks the outstanding follow-up work. Feature is behind `EXPO_PUBLIC_FF_ROMAN_COMPETENCE_PILL` (default-OFF) so there is no production blast radius today, but the PR is not R81-clean and cannot be flag-flipped until findings are closed.

## What's required
- [ ] **F1 (P2)** Missing flag-off static pin for `romanCompetencePill` — no test proving default-OFF, `HabitsScreen`/`MessagesScreen` render gates, or fetch suppression under flag-off — `src/config/featureFlags.ts:342`, `src/screens/client/HabitsScreen.tsx:377-384`, `src/screens/client/MessagesScreen.tsx:132-140,464-471` — fix: add `romanCompetencePillFlagOff.test.ts` asserting false fallback, both render gates, and no network call under flag-off
- [ ] **F2 (P2)** `HabitsScreen` consumes `coach_reviewed_at` through unguarded cast with no runtime type guard — `src/screens/client/HabitsScreen.tsx:90-107` — fix: type `useTodayCheckIn` with a response interface including `coach_reviewed_at?: string | null`; add runtime accessor: `typeof raw === 'string' ? raw : null`
- [ ] **N1 (P2)** `CompetencePill` uses `importantForAccessibility="no"` instead of `"no-hide-descendants"` — Android TalkBack can still reach the child `RomanAvatar` image — `src/components/roman/CompetencePill.tsx:96-106` — fix: change to `importantForAccessibility="no-hide-descendants"` and keep `accessibilityElementsHidden`; add RNTL assertion or static pin
- [ ] **N2 (P2)** Malformed `reviewedAt` strings produce `"on undefined NaN"` — no `Number.isFinite(then.getTime())` guard — `src/lib/roman/copy.ts:582-603` — fix: add finite-date guard; hide pill if invalid (prefer) or return safe fallback; add direct tests
- [ ] **F3 (P3)** `earlier today` branch is unreachable dead code — `src/lib/roman/copy.ts:569-603` — fix: remove the branch and update the bucket comment/test comments
- [ ] **F4 (P3)** `copy.test.ts` has no coverage for `romanCoachReview*` helpers — `src/lib/roman/__tests__/copy.test.ts` — fix: add direct tests for all buckets, future-timestamp collapse, surface variants, malformed input (after N2 fix)

## Already resolved
Pre-merge audit + post-merge re-audit complete. Findings list above is verified against current `main`.
